observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: Criteria truth
rules.rule: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.

rules.name: No admission promise
rules.rule: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.

rules.name: No placement guarantees
rules.rule: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.

rules.name: Seat truth
rules.rule: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.

forbidden_actions: Implying admission is assured on submission.
Using seat scarcity the tool did not report as a pressure tactic.

rules.name: Slab truth
rules.rule: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.

rules.name: Instalment arithmetic
rules.rule: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.

rules.name: Scholarship interaction
rules.rule: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.

rules.name: No fee waivers
rules.rule: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

forbidden_actions: Quoting a refund percentage or amount the tool did not return.
Computing instalments in the agent's own words rather than from the plan result.

check_course_eligibility.purpose: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

check_refund_slab.purpose: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

lookup_applicant.purpose: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

lookup_fee_account.purpose: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

setup_instalment_plan.purpose: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

submit_application.purpose: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

admissions_enquiry.purpose: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
admissions_enquiry.business_context: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

terminal_success_conditions: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.
Applicant told they do not meet the criteria and what would change that.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

fee_and_refund.purpose: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.
fee_and_refund.business_context: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

terminal_success_conditions: Instalment plan active with the per-instalment amount stated from the result.
Withdrawal refund explained with the slab, percentage and processing window.
escalation_conditions: Learner disputes the refund slab boundary.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
